newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Meat says US unit sues former exec.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Meat says US unit sues former exec.

text.p: Day-Lee Foods Inc, a U.S. unit of Nippon Meat Packers Inc, is suing a former executive and his wife to seek payment of $95 million for alleged embezzlement, Nippon Meat said on Tuesday.
Nippon Meat's wholly owned subsidiary, based in California, has filed the complaint with the Superior Court of the State of California in Los Angeles, Nippon Meat said in a statement.
The complaint has been filed against Day-Lee's former executive Yasuyoshi Kato, his wife and the companies they owned, the Japanese meat packing firm said.
Last week, Nippon Meat said that Kato was suspected of embezzling between $80 million and $100 million while employed by the company.
Nippon Meat did not say when Kato left Day-Lee.
Day-Lee is involved in meat processing as well as import and export of their Nippon Meat products.
